conventions.commits: Conventional Commits with type(scope): subject format; all commits must be GPG-signed with --signoff flag; types include feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore
conventions.testing: Unit tests in language module files (mod.rs pattern); integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/; test functions verify query compilation, element extraction, inheritance extraction, and defuse sites
conventions.linting: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -- -D warnings enforced; workspace lints deny undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (test-code exemptions via cfg_attr)
conventions.error_handling: thiserror for error types; bounds checking on node.end_byte() <= source.len() before string slicing; Option-based returns for fallible operations; no unwrap() in production code paths

patterns: Language modules in crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/ define ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY as &str constants
extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance are optional handler functions taking Node and source &str
LanguageInfo struct wired in get_language_info match arm with tree-sitter language binding and all query/handler fields
get_ts_language function provides fallback language binding for cases where full LanguageInfo is not needed
EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs maps file extensions to language identifiers; language_for_extension performs case-insensitive lookup
Tree-sitter queries use field-based capture syntax (e.g., name: (identifier) @capture_name) and node kind matching
Inheritance extraction walks child nodes to find base_clause and class_interface_clause (not field-based in most grammars)
DEFUSE_QUERY captures write sites (local declarations, assignments) and read sites (identifier usage) with @write.* and @read.* tags

extract_inheritance handler is required for OOP languages (Java, Python, TypeScript, Go, C++, C#, JavaScript, Kotlin, Swift have it)
New language module must include SPDX header: // SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 aptu-coder contributors and // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
test_coverage: Existing language modules have unit tests verifying: (1) query compilation via tree_sitter::Query::new, (2) element extraction via ELEMENT_QUERY matching, (3) function name extraction via extract_function_name handler, (4) receiver type extraction via find_receiver_type handler, (5) method-for-receiver extraction via find_method_for_receiver handler, (6) inheritance extraction via extract_inheritance handler, (7) defuse sites via SemanticExtractor::extract_def_use_for_file. Integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/integration_tests.rs verify end-to-end file analysis for each language.

library_findings.relevant_api: Language, Node, Query, QueryCursor, Parser; field-based node access via child_by_field_name(); named child iteration via named_child(index); kind() for node type; start_byte()/end_byte() for source slicing
library_findings.notes: Core parsing library; all language grammars depend on this version. Query syntax uses @capture_name for captures and field: (node_type) @name for field-based matching.

library_findings.relevant_api: Node kinds: function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration, base_clause (extends), class_interface_clause (implements). Field names: name (on all declaration types), body (declaration_list or enum_declaration_list). No parent_class/base_classes/interfaces fields; inheritance is via child nodes.
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar defines 6 declaration kinds for functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums. Inheritance uses base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) as child nodes, not fields. Verified against Context7 grammar documentation.

approaches.name: Full-featured PHP integration with all handlers
approaches.description: Add php.rs module with ELEMENT_QUERY covering function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration; CALL_QUERY for method/function calls; REFERENCE_QUERY for type identifiers; IMPORT_QUERY for use statements; DEFUSE_QUERY for local variable tracking. Implement extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance handlers. Wire into mod.rs get_language_info and get_ts_language; add tree-sitter-php dependency to Cargo.toml; register 'php' in EXTENSION_MAP for .php extension.
pros: Comprehensive feature parity with Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, Go
Enables full semantic analysis: inheritance, method resolution, def-use tracking
Supports all PHP declaration kinds (functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums)
Consistent with project architecture and test patterns
cons: Larger implementation effort (~300-400 LOC for queries and handlers)
More test cases required (9+ test functions covering all dimensions)
Requires understanding of PHP grammar nuances (base_clause vs class_interface_clause)

approaches.name: Minimal PHP integration without inheritance extraction
approaches.description: Add php.rs module with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY only. Set extract_inheritance to None in LanguageInfo. Implement only extract_function_name handler. Wire into mod.rs and Cargo.toml. This mirrors the CSS/YAML pattern but with defuse tracking.
cons: Less useful for method resolution and class hierarchy analysis
Inconsistent with OOP-language pattern in codebase
May require future refactoring when inheritance is needed

approaches.name: PHP with DEFUSE_QUERY but no inheritance (recommended middle ground)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY. Implement extract_function_name and extract_inheritance handlers. Set find_receiver_type and find_method_for_receiver to None. This provides variable tracking and inheritance extraction without method-receiver resolution.
pros: DEFUSE_QUERY is required for semantic correctness (variable tracking)
Inheritance extraction enables class hierarchy analysis
Aligns with Java/Python/TypeScript pattern (most have inheritance but not all have receiver handlers)
cons: Method-receiver resolution not available (less precise call analysis)
Still requires careful grammar understanding for base_clause/class_interface_clause

recommendation: Approach 3 (PHP with DEFUSE_QUERY and inheritance, no receiver handlers). Rationale: (1) DEFUSE_QUERY is architecturally required for semantic correctness and consistency with other OOP languages; (2) extract_inheritance is essential for class hierarchy analysis; (3) extract_function_name is straightforward given PHP's simple function name field; (4) Skipping find_receiver_type and find_method_for_receiver reduces complexity without losing critical functionality (method resolution can fall back to call-site analysis); (5) Moderate complexity (medium) is justified by the language's prevalence and the need for semantic completeness; (6) Aligns with existing patterns in Java, Python, TypeScript, Go implementations.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
(
  (function_definition
    name: (name) @function_name) @function
  (method_declaration
    name: (name) @method_name) @function
  (class_declaration
    name: (name) @class_name) @class
  (interface_declaration
    name: (name) @interface_name) @class
  (trait_declaration
    name: (name) @trait_name) @class
  (enum_declaration
    name: (name) @enum_name) @class
)
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-php grammar (github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php/blob/master/common/define-grammar.js): class_declaration node has no parent_class or interfaces fields. Instead, base_clause and class_interface_clause are optional child nodes (not fields). To extract inheritance: (1) iterate node.named_child(i) for i in 0..node.named_child_count(); (2) check if child.kind() == "base_clause" and extract its first named_child as the extends target; (3) check if child.kind() == "class_interface_clause" and iterate its named_child(j) to extract each implements target. base_clause rule is seq(keyword('extends'), commaSep1($._name)); class_interface_clause rule is seq(keyword('implements'), commaSep1($._name)).
